answer: The prism counter is kept in kernel and oasis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The per-identity price is 110 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
